decisions.reason: As a new, agency-focused compliance tool close to the existing offer, it still has option value under uncertainty and likely low carrying costs, with at least some positive market signal.
Because it builds directly on the core hosting business and was prominent on the home page, management would likely retain this strategically important option and continue learning from it.
A configurable managed hosting plan is very close to the firm’s established business, so the cost of keeping it should be low while demand uncertainty continues to resolve in a growing market.
